name: 89506 · Reno, NV
findings: ZIP 89506 (Reno) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89506 (Reno) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89506 (Reno) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
